cards.content:
{% set ns2 = namespace(dead=[], m6=[]) %}{% set rr = [('Living room','living_room'),('Office','office'),('Bedroom','bedroom'),('Kids room 1','kid1'),('Kids room 2','kid2')] %}{% for n, s in rr %}{% if states('sensor.climate_temp_' ~ s) in ['unknown','unavailable'] and (now() - states['sensor.climate_temp_' ~ s].last_changed).total_seconds() > 600 %}{% set ns2.dead = ns2.dead + [n] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% set night = is_state('binary_sensor.lighting_night','on') %}{% for n, s, tw in [('Bedroom','bedroom','climate.bedroom_trv_bedroom_trv'),('Kids room 1','kid1','climate.kid1_room_trv_kid1_room_trv'),('Kids room 2','kid2','climate.kid2_room_trv_kid2_room_trv')] %}{% set sp = state_attr(tw,'temperature') | float(0) %}{% set at = (states('input_number.climate_target_night_' ~ s) if night else states('input_number.climate_target_day_' ~ s)) | float(20) %}{% if sp > at %}{% set ns2.m6 = ns2.m6 + [n] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% set tv = states('input_number.climate_trv_sensor_offset') | float(0) %}{% set aco = states('input_number.climate_ac_sensor_offset') | float(-2) %}{% set upt = now().timestamp() - (state_attr('input_datetime.climate_ha_started','timestamp') | float(0)) %}{% if ns2.dead %}🛰️ **No temperature reading: {{ ns2.dead | join(', ') }}**

{% endif %}{% if (tv | abs) > 3 or aco < -3.5 %}⚠️ **Sensor calibration looks wrong**

{% endif %}{% if ns2.m6 %}♨️ **Radiator above target: {{ ns2.m6 | join(', ') }}**

{% endif %}{% if upt > 34560000 %}⚠️ **Restart stamp is stale**

{% endif %}{% set b = states('input_number.climate_breaker_threshold') | int(3) %}{% set rooms = [('Living room','counter.climate_fail_living_room','input_datetime.climate_manual_until_living_room'),('Office','counter.climate_fail_office','input_datetime.climate_manual_until_office'),('Bedroom','counter.climate_fail_bedroom','input_datetime.climate_manual_until_bedroom'),('Kids room 1','counter.climate_fail_kid1','input_datetime.climate_manual_until_kid1'),('Kids room 2','counter.climate_fail_kid2','input_datetime.climate_manual_until_kid2')] %}{% set ns = namespace(bad=[], held=[]) %}{% for n, c, m in rooms %}{% if states(c) | int(0) >= b %}{% set ns.bad = ns.bad + [n] %}{% endif %}{% set t = state_attr(m,'timestamp') %}{% if t and now().timestamp() < t %}{% set ns.held = ns.held + [n] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% set hbo = states('input_number.climate_heat_below_outdoor') | float(17) %}{% set cao = states('input_number.climate_cool_above_outdoor') | float(20) %}{% if ns.bad %}🔌 **Not responding: {{ ns.bad | join(', ') }}**

{% endif %}{% if ns.held %}✋ **Manual hold: {{ ns.held | join(', ') }}**

{% endif %}{% if hbo >= cao %}⚠️ **House band inverted** ({{ hbo }} / {{ cao }})

{% endif %}{% if is_state('input_boolean.climate_safety_always','off') %}⚠️ **Safety limits are OFF**

{% endif %}{% if not ns.bad and not ns.held and hbo < cao and is_state('input_boolean.climate_safety_always','on') %}All five units responding · no manual holds · safety limits on.{% endif %}

{% set ns = namespace(worst = -1, room = '') %}{% for r, n in [('living_room','Living room'), ('office','Office')] %}{% set v = states('sensor.climate_co2_' ~ r) | float(-1) %}{% if v > ns.worst %}{% set ns.worst = v %}{% set ns.room = n %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if ns.worst < 0 %}No CO₂ reading.{% elif ns.worst >= 1400 %}**{{ ns.room }} {{ ns.worst | int }} ppm — open a window.**{% elif ns.worst >= 1000 %}**{{ ns.room }} {{ ns.worst | int }} ppm** — stuffy{% else %}Highest {{ ns.room }} {{ ns.worst | int }} ppm — fresh{% endif %}

<details><summary><ha-icon icon="mdi:information-outline"></ha-icon></summary>

Below 1000 ppm the air is fresh. From 1000 ppm a room is stuffy, the usual sign it has been shut too long: worth airing. From 1400 ppm, open a window.

</details>

filter.template: {%- set pal = ['#ff9800','#3f51b5','#9c27b0','#e91e63','#00bcd4','#8bc34a','#795548','#009688','#ffc107','#607d8b','#f44336','#673ab7'] -%}{%- set ns = namespace(l=[]) -%}{%- for s in states.sensor | selectattr('attributes.device_class','defined') | selectattr('attributes.device_class','eq','temperature') -%}{%- set a = area_id(s.entity_id) -%}{%- if a and floor_id(s.entity_id) and 'on_room_page' in labels(s.entity_id) -%}{%- set ns.l = ns.l + [(area_name(a), s.entity_id)] -%}{%- endif -%}{%- endfor -%}{%- set rooms = ns.l | sort(attribute='0') -%}{%- set out = namespace(l=[]) -%}{%- for n, e in rooms -%}{%- set out.l = out.l + [{'type': 'custom:mini-graph-card', 'entities': [{'entity': e, 'name': n, 'color': pal[loop.index0 % (pal | count)]}], 'icon': 'mdi:thermometer', 'hours_to_show': 24, 'points_per_hour': 2, 'line_width': 2, 'font_size': 75, 'decimals': 1, 'show': {'name': true, 'icon': true, 'state': true, 'labels': false, 'legend': false, 'fill': 'fade'}}] -%}{%- endfor -%}{{ out.l }}
